Thus the complex is S4. The original complex and once-punctured complexes and full link also have acyclic certificates. Because removed antipodes are at distance five, the second vertex link is unchanged by deleting the first; both relative cofibers are wedges of five S7. The long exact sequences prove primitive sequential losses and H4 isomorphisms.
